heading: 53-year-old single father loses 30 kg in 18 months: The reason behind his fitness journey will move you
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: A father from Mumbai went from 115 kg weigh to 85 kg weight in order to ‘outlive’ his son. The 53-year-old Indian man shared that he decided to get healthy to become the primary care giver of his son with special needs. Check his emotional story.
